summary: Temp Control Heating & Air Conditioning is a locally owned residential and commercial HVAC contractor founded in 2003 by Shai Lalush, headquartered at 209 Main Street in Woodbridge, NJ, with additional locations in Freehold and Westfield. It sells repair, replacement, maintenance agreements and indoor-air-quality work, runs 24/7 emergency service, and covers 118+ communities across Middlesex, Union, Monmouth and Somerset counties. Growth from a one-truck operation to a multi-location crew is now supported by utility rebate/financing programs (PSE&G, Elizabethtown Gas, Synchrony), while intake, scheduling and dispatch still run through a phone number and a web form rather than self-service booking.

facts.fact: Founded in 2003 by owner Shai Lalush as a one-person HVAC technician business in Edison, NJ, later headquartered in Woodbridge and expanded to a crew of technicians and installers.
Office address is 209 Main Street, Woodbridge, NJ 07095; the contact page lists additional locations in Freehold, NJ and Westfield, NJ.
Holds NJ HVAC license 19HC00277400, displayed in the site header/footer on every page.

Service lines include AC and heating repair, system installation and replacement, preventative maintenance, furnace and boiler service, heat pumps, ductwork, indoor air quality, ductless and zoning, oil-to-gas conversions and smart thermostats, for both homes and businesses.
Serves Middlesex, Union, Monmouth and Somerset Counties and states coverage of 118+ communities across Central New Jersey.
Advertises 24/7 emergency heating and AC service and says emergency calls are prioritized for Woodbridge and nearby towns.
Service requests are taken by phone at 732-218-8400 or through the website contact form; the contact page shows an 'Email' label but no email address, and no calendar/online booking link.
Offers a $299 residential maintenance agreement with two annual visits (spring and fall) and 15% off parts and labor for agreement customers.

Financing options include PSE&G and Elizabethtown Gas on-bill 0% programs up to $25,000 plus promotional Synchrony Bank financing, with the company listed as a participating contractor in both utility programs.
Carries the full Coleman line and displays badges for Nest Certified Professional, Fujitsu, Bosch, Green Seal and a 2024 PSE&G Energy Efficiency Trade Ally award.
Team page names five people: Shai Lalush (Founder & President), an Office Administrator, a Field Manager, an Installation Specialist and one HVAC Tech.
A dedicated ShopRite NJ landing page exists, indicating commercial retail HVAC work alongside residential service.
For its 20th anniversary in 2023 the company pledged $20 per sale to Hands of Hope Food Pantry, targeting $20,000 in donations based on projected revenue.

operations_signals: Intake is phone-first (732-218-8400) or a contact/quote form; no online scheduling calendar, customer portal or chat widget was found on the home or contact pages (https://tempcontrolnj.com/contact-us/)

Contact page displays an 'Email' heading with no address published, and no business hours are stated anywhere on the home or contact pages; only '24/7 emergency' is promised (https://tempcontrolnj.com/contact-us/)

24/7 emergency coverage is delivered by on-call technicians; a published testimonial describes an on-call serviceman arriving Saturday night after a long prior shift (https://tempcontrolnj.com/testimonials/)
Service area spans four counties and 118+ named communities from one HQ plus Freehold and Westfield locations, so dispatch routes cover a wide geography (https://tempcontrolnj.com/service-areas/)

Recurring-revenue maintenance agreement ($299, two visits/year, 15% parts-and-labor discount) plus a $25 Amazon gift-card referral program create repeat scheduling and tracking work (https://tempcontrolnj.com/hvac-freehold-nj/, https://tempcontrolnj.com/promos/)
Every install may involve utility rebate and financing paperwork across PSE&G, Elizabethtown Gas on-bill repayment and Synchrony credit applications (https://tempcontrolnj.com/hvac-financing/)
The team page lists exactly one Office Administrator for phone/form intake, scheduling and back-office admin across three locations (https://tempcontrolnj.com/team/)
hiring_signals: No careers, employment or 'join our team' page exists on the site; /careers/, /employment/ and /join-our-team/ all return HTTP 404, so hiring is not publicly advertised on the company website (https://tempcontrolnj.com/careers/)
A SimplyHired search for 'temp control hvac' in Woodbridge, NJ returned zero matching job postings at the time of research (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=temp+control+hvac&l=Woodbridge%2C+NJ)

Only five roles are publicly named on the team page (Founder/President, Office Administrator, Field Manager, Installation Specialist, HVAC Tech), which points to a small office and field crew (https://tempcontrolnj.com/team/)

Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor blocked automated access (HTTP 403), so current job requisitions could not be verified on those boards (https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=%22Temp+Control%22+HVAC&l=Woodbridge%2C+NJ)
review_themes: Company-published testimonials (three, undated) praise same-day estimates, fast installs and a weekend emergency repair; they are curated marketing content, so negative themes are absent (https://tempcontrolnj.com/testimonials/)

Owner messaging attributes growth to responsiveness and listening to customer concerns, framing speed of response as the differentiator (https://tempcontrolnj.com/temp-control-celebrates-20-years-of-five-star-hvac/)
Marketing copy leans hard on 'five-star' service and upfront, no-surprise pricing claims, which suggests price transparency is a sensitive topic for its customer base (https://tempcontrolnj.com/)
tech_footprint: Website runs WordPress with the Beaver Builder page builder and Yoast SEO; the site was actively updated through 2026 per sitemap last-modified dates (https://tempcontrolnj.com/page-sitemap.xml)
Google Site Kit analytics plus a Google Ads conversion tag (AW-11398007189) load on every page inspected, indicating paid-search investment (https://tempcontrolnj.com/)
Lead capture uses Gravity Forms; no Calendly/ServiceTitan/Housecall Pro booking widget, no live chat and no customer portal were detected on the contact page (https://tempcontrolnj.com/contact-us/)
Certification and brand badges displayed site-wide: Nest Certified Professional, Coleman, Fujitsu, Bosch, Green Seal and PSE&G Trade Ally (https://tempcontrolnj.com/emergency-hvac-service/)
Facebook (facebook.com/tempcontrolnj) is the only social profile declared in the site's structured data (https://tempcontrolnj.com/)
Publishes a blog/HVAC tips library and 100+ town-level service pages, but no published price list or online quote calculator (https://tempcontrolnj.com/post-sitemap.xml)
growth_signals: Added Freehold and Westfield locations beyond the Woodbridge headquarters (https://tempcontrolnj.com/contact-us/)
Grew from a single technician with one truck in 2003 to a multi-person technician and installer crew (https://tempcontrolnj.com/temp-control-celebrates-20-years-of-five-star-hvac/)

Marked its 20th anniversary in 2023 with a year-long community campaign and a $20,000 donation goal tied to projected sales volume (https://tempcontrolnj.com/temp-control-celebrates-20-years-of-five-star-hvac/)

Recognized as a 2024 PSE&G Energy Efficiency Trade Ally and is a participating contractor in PSE&G and Elizabethtown Gas rebate/financing programs (https://tempcontrolnj.com/emergency-hvac-service/, https://tempcontrolnj.com/hvac-financing/)
Service footprint now marketed as 118+ communities across four counties (https://tempcontrolnj.com/service-areas/)
Dozens of new town-level service pages carry 2026 modification dates, indicating a continuing SEO/content expansion push (https://tempcontrolnj.com/page-sitemap.xml)

inferences.inference: Phone intake and dispatch are probably a bottleneck during heat waves and cold snaps.
inferences.reasoning: A single named Office Administrator handles intake for an operation covering 118+ communities with 24/7 emergency service and three locations; no online booking or after-hours triage tooling is visible, so call volume lands on one person and an on-call tech.

inferences.inference: After-hours emergency calls are triaged manually by a technician rather than a dispatcher.
inferences.reasoning: The only public description of after-hours work is a testimonial about an 'on-call serviceman' arriving Saturday night; the site advertises 24/7 availability but shows no answering service, call-routing or booking software.

inferences.inference: Utility rebate and financing administration is a recurring per-job workload.
inferences.reasoning: The company participates in PSE&G and Elizabethtown Gas on-bill programs plus Synchrony financing, each requiring eligibility checks and paperwork on top of the installation itself.

inferences.inference: Sales volume is on the order of roughly 1,000 jobs a year.
inferences.reasoning: The 2023 anniversary pledge of $20 per sale targeting $20,000 implies about 1,000 sales that year; this is arithmetic on the company's own stated goal, not a reported figure.

inferences.inference: The business is small, likely well under 25 employees.
inferences.reasoning: Five staff are named publicly, there is one office administrator, and no headcount is published; three 'locations' may be service/mailing points rather than fully staffed offices.

inferences.inference: Hiring is reactive and referral-driven rather than pipeline-driven.
inferences.reasoning: There is no careers page, no postings surfaced on accessible job boards, and the site's growth messaging focuses on customer service rather than recruiting.

inferences.inference: Marketing spend is tilting toward paid search plus local SEO rather than self-service tools.
inferences.reasoning: A Google Ads conversion tag and Site Kit are installed on every page and 100+ town pages were recently touched, yet the only conversion path is a form or phone call.

data_gaps: Independent review data could not be collected: Google Business Profile, Yelp, BBB, Angi and Thumbtack returned HTTP 403 or blocked automated access, and web search providers were rate-limited for the entire session.
Therefore star ratings, review counts, complaint themes (missed calls, billing errors, scheduling delays) and response-rate behavior are unknown.
Current job postings could not be verified: Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor blocked access; SimplyHired showed zero matches for a name-based query, which is inconclusive.
Business hours, email address, headcount, revenue and whether Freehold/Westfield are staffed offices or service points are not published.
No public information found on dispatch software, CRM or accounting system in use.
All review and team information used here is company-published content, not third-party verification.
